item.tib: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gtor bskang
item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i bskang (skong)bshags/ mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i(mas)/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po la brgyud/ bstan 'dzin slob ma rnams la rim par brgyud pa'o/dam nyams ru tra'i lag tu ma shor cig/

item.tib: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gtor skong
item.coloph: rgya gar bon gyi bka' lung / rig 'dzin thugs kyi gsang bcud/ 'od ldan 'bar ma'i snyan rgyud/ ithi sa ma yA/ rgya rgya rgya/ de ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i skong bshags mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas sprul sku blo ldan snying po la brgyud pa'o//
